name: Requital
detailed_description:
The Moment Time Shattered



On a day lost within time, I saw eternity in her eyes as I kissed her for the last time.
But a time traveler changed fate… and stole the woman I loved.
Now, I’m not chasing the past — I’m chasing him.
Through time and space, I search for him… and my revenge.
Because some loves leave marks that not even eternity can erase.

ABOUT THIS GAME



Requital is the story of how far a lover is willing to go — or how far back.
An unrelenting chase, an epic tale of love, and a physically intense rhythm-action experience fueled by adrenaline-pumping beats.
From the Wild West to forgotten lands, from post-apocalyptic wastelands to cities of the resurrected — you’ll pursue your vengeance across time and space.
Take control of your weapons. Duck, dodge, and strike.
Master your guns — first against enemies, then in harmony with the music.
Each world you step into carries its own style, its own tone, and a rhythm all its own.
Every chapter features a unique genre of music that drives your combat and guides your movements.
And this… is only the beginning.
Dive in, feel the rhythm, survive — and make them all pay.

short_description: Requital is a fast-paced, rhythm-based VR shooter where precision define survival. Travel through past and future timelines, eliminating enemies in music-driven combat encounters. Each level is handcrafted to sync perfectly with intense, pulse-pounding soundtracks. Move, shoot and stay on beat.
